info.name: FieldForce CRM - All APIs
info.description:
Complete scope: every API endpoint in the FieldForce backend, generated directly from the live backend route/validator source on 2026-10-23. Every endpoint below is real and currently deployed - nothing here is guessed.

- Base URL points at production: https://devcrm.nextechltd.in/api
- All endpoints (except Login/Refresh/Logout/Register, and the handful of genuinely public or webhook endpoints noted in their own folder/description) require `Authorization: Bearer <accessToken>`. This collection handles that for you via the `accessToken` collection variable - just run "Login" first and every other request will auto-use the token.
- Every response is wrapped as `{ success: boolean, data: ..., message?: string }`. On error: `{ success: false, message: string, errors?: ... }` with a 4xx/5xx status code.
- Most endpoints are gated by a permission string (shown in each request's description, e.g. `leads.view`). If a user's role doesn't have that permission, the API returns 403.
- A few folders (Public QR, Public Website Leads, Frappe Webhooks, and specific webhook routes inside the Integrations folders) are genuinely NOT behind a user token - their descriptions explain the real mechanism (rate limiting only, or a shared-secret/HMAC signature header). Those are marked `noauth` and are mostly not relevant to a mobile app's own login flow.
- This collection folds in and supersedes FieldForce-Login-Leads.postman_collection.json (Auth + Leads folders are unchanged / reused here) and adds every other module in the CRM.

request.description: No auth header required - the refresh token itself is the credential. Call this when the access token expires instead of logging in again. Response: `{ success: true, data: { accessToken: string }, message: "Token refreshed" }`. Auto-updates the `accessToken` collection variable.

Revokes the given refresh token server-side. Always returns success even if the token was already invalid/expired - the client should discard its local tokens regardless. Response: `{ success: true, data: null, message: "Logged out" }`.

Requires: valid access token (no specific permission). Returns the logged-in user's full profile plus their resolved `permissions` array - use this to decide what to show/hide in the mobile app. Response: `{ success: true, data: { id, name, email, role, ..., permissions: string[] } }`.

item.name: Register User (Admin only - not a mobile login flow)

request.description:
Requires permission: `users.create`, called with an ADMIN's own access token (not public self-signup - there's no public registration in this API). Included here for completeness since it lives on the auth router, but the mobile app's own login screen will only ever call Login/Refresh/Logout/Me above.

Either `role` (admin/manager/agent) or `levelId` must be provided. Response: `{ success: true, data: <new user object>, message: "User created" }`, 201.

Requires permission: `leads.view`. All query params are optional except none are required - `page`/`limit` default to 1/20 if omitted. Returns the caller's visible leads (scoped server-side by role/ownership), paginated.

Requires permission: `leads.create`. Only `fullName` is required - every other field is optional (there are ~50 optional fields across Customer/Contact/Inquiry/Store/FOFO/Consent tabs; the body above shows commonly-used ones). Response 201: `{ success: true, data: <new lead>, message: "Lead created" }`.

Requires permission: `leads.create`. `rows`: 1-5000 row objects. Deliberately lenient/loose validation per-row (unlike Create Lead) so one bad row doesn't block the other hundreds - bad rows are reported individually in the response instead of 400ing the whole request. Response: `{ success: true, data: { <per-row import results/summary> }, message: "Import complete" }`.
Requires permission: `leads.view`. Returns the distinct list of territory strings already in use across leads - useful for populating a picker. Response: `{ success: true, data: string[] }`.

Requires permission: `leads.view`. Returns badge counts for the standard quick filters, scoped to the caller. Response: `{ success: true, data: { all, myLeads, unassigned, overdue, fofo, highScore } }` (all numbers).
Requires permission: `leads.view`. Response: `{ success: true, data: <full lead record> }`.

Requires permission: `leads.update`. Body is a partial version of Create Lead's body - send only the fields you want to change. Response: `{ success: true, data: <updated lead>, message: "Lead updated" }`.
Requires permission: `leads.delete`. Response: `{ success: true, data: null, message: "Lead deleted" }`.
Requires permission: `leads.view`. Lists which users (besides the owner) this lead is currently shared with. Response: `{ success: true, data: [...] }`.
Requires permission: `leads.share`. `userId` must be a real user's uuid. Response 201: `{ success: true, data: null, message: "Lead shared" }`.
Requires permission: `leads.share`. Response: `{ success: true, data: null, message: "Share removed" }`.
Requires permission: `opportunities.view`. Response: `{ success: true, data: [...] }`.
Requires permission: `opportunities.create`. Every field in the body is optional. Response: `{ success: true, data: <new opportunity> }`.
Requires permission: `activities.view`. Response: `{ success: true, data: [...] }`.

Requires permission: `activities.create`. `type` is required - one of: call, email, teams_meeting, site_visit, whatsapp, internal, support_ticket. Everything else is optional. Response 201: `{ success: true, data: <new activity> }`.
Requires permission: `leads.view`. Response: `{ success: true, data: <consent record or null> }`.
Requires permission: `quotes.view`. Response: `{ success: true, data: [...] }`.
Requires permission: `support_tickets.view`. Response: `{ success: true, data: [...] }`.

formdata.value: Hi, following up on our conversation...

formdata.description: optional override, defaults to the lead's own email

request.description: Requires permission: `activities.create`. IMPORTANT: this is `multipart/form-data`, not JSON, because of the optional file attachments (max 5) - do not switch the body mode to raw JSON. `subject` and `body` are required text fields. Sends via the connected Microsoft (Outlook) account. Response: `{ success: true, data: <sent-mail/activity info> }`.
Requires permission: `activities.create`. All three fields (`subject`, `startTime`, `endTime`) are required ISO-ish strings. Response: `{ success: true, data: <created Teams meeting info> }`.

Requires permission: `activities.create`. Both fields optional - with neither, dials the lead's own registered phone number via Smartflo (click-to-call). `contactName` is display-only, shown on the logged call activity. Response: `{ success: true, data: <call session info> }`.
Requires permission: `whatsapp.view`. Response: `{ success: true, data: [...] }`.
Requires permission: `whatsapp.send`. `body`: 1-4096 chars. Response 201: `{ success: true, data: <sent message> }`.

Requires permission: `users.view`. Query params `page`/`limit` are both optional (default 1/50, limit max 200). Response: `{ success: true, data: { users: [...], total } }` (paginated, scoped by role - Admin sees everyone including inactive, others see within their own tree).
Requires permission: `users.create`. Preview-only value (not reserved) for pre-filling the Create User form. Response: `{ success: true, data: { employeeCode: string } }`.
Requires permission: `users.view`. Returns the distinct list of territory strings already in use across users. Response: `{ success: true, data: string[] }`.

Requires: valid access token (no specific permission) - self-service, always targets the caller's own account. Only field allowed is `smartfloAgentNumber` (optional, min 1 char) - every other profile field is admin-only via Update User below. Response: `{ success: true, data: <updated user>, message: "Profile updated" }`.

Requires permission: `users.update`. All fields optional (partial update) - includes name, designation, managerId/dottedLineManagerId/salesTeamId/zoneId/stateId/levelId/officeId/divisionChannelId/customerCategoryId (uuid or "" to clear), smartfloAgentNumber, mobile, territory, employeeCode, dateOfJoining, `status` (active/on_leave/onboarding/exited), `isActive` (boolean), `operationType` (COCO/FOFO/Both or ""), and `pincodes` (string array, full replace). Response: `{ success: true, data: <updated user>, message: "User updated" }`.
Requires permission: `users.reset_password` (deliberately separate from `users.update`). `newPassword` is required, min 8 chars. Response: `{ success: true, data: null, message: "Password reset" }`.

Requires permission: `users.view`. Read-only simulation ("Test access as...") of what the target user's own scope resolves to today - never actually signs in as them. Admin can inspect anyone; others only within their own reporting subtree. Response: `{ success: true, data: { id, name, territory, managerName, levelName, approvesUpTo, directReports, ownLeadCount, teamPeopleBelow, teamLeadCountBelow, peers } }`.

Requires permission: `levels.view`. Query params `page`/`limit` optional (default 1/50). Response: `{ success: true, data: { levels: [...], total } }` (paginated, each level includes its current headcount).

Requires permission: `levels.create`. Only `name` is required. Optional: `sortOrder` (int), `description`, `headcountLimit`/`approvalCeiling` (numbers), `securityTier` (admin/manager/agent/call_center), `recordScope` (own_only/own_and_below/own_below_peers_readonly/whole_region/everything), `isCrossCutting`/`seeCreditFields`/`seeMarginFields`/`canExport`/`canViewCallRecordings`/`canSeeUnmaskedPii` (booleans), and label overrides (`seesLabelOverride`, `approvalLabelOverride`, `canEditLabel`). Response 201: `{ success: true, data: <new level>, message: "Level created" }`.

Requires permission: `levels.update`. Same optional fields as Create Level (partial update); `headcountLimit`/`approvalCeiling` and the label overrides also accept `null` to clear them. Response: `{ success: true, data: <updated level>, message: "Level updated" }`.
Requires permission: `offices.view`. Query params `page`/`limit` optional (default 1/50). Response: `{ success: true, data: { offices: [...], total } }` (paginated).
Requires permission: `offices.view`. Response: `{ success: true, data: <office record> }`.

Requires permission: `offices.create`. Only `name` is required. Optional: `region`, `code`, `type` (head_office/regional_office/branch), `address`/`addressLine2`/`city`/`pincode`, `zoneId`/`stateId` (uuid), `phone`, `latitude` (-90..90), `longitude` (-180..180), `isActive` (boolean). Response 201: `{ success: true, data: <new office>, message: "Office created" }`.

Requires permission: `offices.update`. Same optional fields as Create Office (partial update); `zoneId`/`stateId` also accept "" to clear. Response: `{ success: true, data: <updated office>, message: "Office updated" }`.
Requires permission: `sales_teams.view`. Query params `page`/`limit` optional (default 1/50). Response: `{ success: true, data: { salesTeams: [...], total } }` (paginated).
Requires permission: `sales_teams.create`. Only `name` is required; `region` is optional. Response 201: `{ success: true, data: <new sales team>, message: "Sales team created" }`.
Requires: valid access token (no specific permission). Query params `page`/`limit` optional (default 1/50). Response: `{ success: true, data: { zones: [...], total } }` (paginated).

Requires: valid access token (no specific permission). `zoneId` is an optional uuid filter; `page`/`limit` optional (default 1/50). Response: `{ success: true, data: { states: [...], total } }` (paginated).
Requires permission: `structure_axis.view`. Query params `page`/`limit` optional (default 1/50). Response: `{ success: true, data: { structureAxes: [...], total } }` (paginated).

Requires permission: `structure_axis.update`. `isEnabled` (boolean) is required - toggles whether this org-structure axis is in use. Response: `{ success: true, data: <updated axis>, message: "Structure axis updated" }`.

query.description: uuid, optional filter to one user's history

request.description: Requires permission: `manager_change_log.view`. `userId` is an optional uuid filter; `page`/`limit` optional (default 1/50). This is a read-only audit trail - entries are only ever written automatically by a manager-change hook in user-service.ts, never via a dedicated write endpoint. Response: `{ success: true, data: [...] }` (paginated list of change-log entries).
Requires permission: `user_permission_overrides.view`. Response: `{ success: true, data: [...] }` (each override's grant/revoke record for this user, including who created/cleared it).

Requires permission: `user_permission_overrides.create`. Required: `userId` (uuid), `permission` (non-empty string), `grantType` ("grant" or "revoke"). Optional: `reason` (max 255 chars), `expiresAt` (ISO date string). Response 201: `{ success: true, data: <new override>, message: "Override created" }`.
Requires permission: `user_permission_overrides.delete`. Clears a single override by its id. Response: `{ success: true, data: null, message: "Override cleared" }`.

Requires permission: `user_permission_overrides.delete`. Clears every active override for this user in one call. Response: `{ success: true, data: { cleared: number }, message: "Overrides cleared" }`.

Requires permission: `role_permissions.view`. Response: `{ success: true, data: { catalog: string[], roles: string[], grants: { [role]: string[] }, defaults: { [role]: string[] } } }` - the full permission catalog plus each role's current grants and factory defaults.

Requires permission: `role_permissions.update`. Required: `role` (admin/manager/agent/call_center), `permission` (non-empty string), `granted` (boolean). The service layer refuses any change that would leave zero roles holding `role_permissions.update`, to prevent a total lockout. Response: `{ success: true, data: <full updated matrix, same shape as List>, message: "Role permissions updated" }`.

Requires permission: `role_permissions.update`. Required: `role` (admin/manager/agent/call_center). Reverts every permission grant for that role back to its factory default set. Response: `{ success: true, data: <full updated matrix>, message: "Role reset to default" }`.

Requires permission: `role_permissions.update`. Required: `role` - one of manager/agent/call_center (admin is deliberately excluded as a target, since it makes no sense to grant Admin access to Admin). Grants that role every permission Administrator has. Response: `{ success: true, data: <full updated matrix>, message: "Full Administrator access granted" }`.

Requires: valid access token (no specific permission). `latitude`/`longitude` are both optional. Fails with 409 if already checked in. Response 201: `{ success: true, data: <attendance record>, message: "Checked in" }`.

Requires: valid access token (no specific permission). `latitude`/`longitude` are both optional. Fails with 409 if not currently checked in. Response: `{ success: true, data: <attendance record>, message: "Checked out" }`.

Requires: valid access token (no specific permission). Both `latitude` and `longitude` are required. Fails with 409 if the user is not currently checked in. Response 201: `{ success: true, data: null, message: "Location recorded" }`.
Requires: valid access token (no specific permission). Returns the caller's latest attendance record and its status. Response: `{ success: true, data: { status, attendance: <record or null> } }`.
Requires: valid access token (no specific permission). Returns the caller's last 100 attendance records, newest first. Response: `{ success: true, data: [<attendance record>, ...] }`.

Requires: valid access token (no specific permission). Returns each of the caller's reporting-chain subordinates with their latest check-in/check-out status. Response: `{ success: true, data: [{ userId, name, email, status, checkInAt, checkOutAt }, ...] }`.

Requires: valid access token (no specific permission). `userId` must be in the caller's reporting-chain subtree, otherwise 403. Response: `{ success: true, data: [<attendance record>, ...] }` (last 100, newest first).
Requires: valid access token (no specific permission). Caller must be in the record owner's reporting chain, otherwise 403; 404 if not found. Response: `{ success: true, data: <attendance record> }`.

Requires: valid access token (no specific permission). Computes total travelled distance from the location pings recorded during that attendance window. Response: `{ success: true, data: { attendanceId, pointCount, totalDistanceKm } }`.
Requires permission: `leave_types.view`. Both query params optional, default page=1/limit=50. Response: `{ success: true, data: [<leave type incl. balances config>, ...] }`.

Requires permission: `leave_types.manage`. `{{leaveTypeKey}}` is one of: casual, sick, earned, comp_off, half_day, wfh. Every field is optional - send only what you want to change (`annualDays`/`accrualPerMonth`/`carryForwardCap` are numbers >= 0 or null; `maxConsecutiveDays`/`noticeDays`/`medicalNoteAfterDays`/`expiresAfterDays` are integers >= 0 or null; `requiresSecondApprover` boolean; `policyNote` 1-200 chars). Response: `{ success: true, data: <updated leave type>, message: "Leave type updated" }`.

Requires permission: `leave_requests.view`. Returns the caller's entitlement/used/available days per leave type for the current year. Response: `{ success: true, data: [<leave type with entitlement, used, available>, ...] }`.

Requires permission: `leave_requests.view`. Returns the caller's manager, peers (same manager) and direct reports - used to populate the `coverUserId` picker on the leave request form. Response: `{ success: true, data: { managerId, managerName, peers: [{id,name}], directReports: [{id,name}] } }`.
Requires permission: `leave_requests.view`. Returns all of the caller's own leave requests, newest first. Response: `{ success: true, data: [<leave request>, ...] }`.

Requires permission: `leave_requests.approve`. Direct reports only (not the whole subtree), restricted to requests overlapping the next 30 days and not cancelled. Response: `{ success: true, data: [<leave request>, ...] }`.
Requires permission: `leave_requests.approve`. Returns pending requests where the caller is the current (1st or 2nd tier) approver. Response: `{ success: true, data: [<leave request>, ...] }`.

Requires permission: `leave_requests.approve`. Searches every leave request across the caller's whole reporting-chain subtree (not just direct reports), optionally filtered to one `userId` and/or a `from`/`to` date range (e.g. a month's first/last day). Response: `{ success: true, data: [<leave request>, ...] }`.

Requires permission: `leave_requests.create`. `kind` (one of: casual, sick, earned, comp_off, half_day, wfh), `startDate`, `endDate` (both YYYY-MM-DD) and `reason` (1-500 chars) are required; `coverUserId` (uuid) is optional. Response 201: `{ success: true, data: <new leave request>, message: "Leave request submitted" }`.

Requires permission: `leave_requests.approve`. `decision` is required: `approved` or `rejected`. Response: `{ success: true, data: <updated leave request>, message: "Request approved" }` (or "Request rejected").
Requires permission: `leave_requests.update`. No body. Response: `{ success: true, data: <updated leave request>, message: "Leave request cancelled" }`.

Requires permission: `comp_off_credits.grant`. `userId` (uuid) and `earnedDate` (YYYY-MM-DD) are required; `reason` (max 255 chars) is optional. Response 201: `{ success: true, data: <updated comp-off balances>, message: "Comp-off granted" }`.
Requires permission: `expense_types.view`. Both query params optional, default page=1/limit=50. Response: `{ success: true, data: [<expense type with per-unit/flat limit config>, ...] }`.
Requires permission: `expense_claims.view`. Returns all of the caller's own expense claims. Response: `{ success: true, data: [<expense claim>, ...] }`.
Requires permission: `expense_claims.approve`. Direct reports only. Response: `{ success: true, data: [<expense claim>, ...] }`.
Requires permission: `expense_claims.approve`. Returns pending claims where the caller is the current (1st or 2nd tier) approver. Response: `{ success: true, data: [<expense claim>, ...] }`.

Requires permission: `expense_claims.approve`. Searches every expense claim across the caller's whole reporting-chain subtree, optionally filtered to one `userId` and/or a `from`/`to` date range. Response: `{ success: true, data: [<expense claim>, ...] }`.

formdata.description: required - one of: travel, fuel, lodging, meals, client_entertainment, telecom, marketing_collateral
optional - km/nights/count, only meaningful for fuel/lodging/meals
optional receipt image/PDF - required by policy for some expense types

request.description: Requires permission: `expense_claims.create`. IMPORTANT: this is `multipart/form-data`, not JSON, because of the optional receipt file - do not switch the body mode to raw JSON. `expenseTypeKey`, `title`, `expenseDate` and `amount` are required text fields; `quantity`, `linkedLeadId`, `linkedOpportunityId` and the `receipt` file are optional. Response 201: `{ success: true, data: <new expense claim>, message: "Expense claim submitted" }`.

Requires permission: `expense_claims.approve`. `decision` is required: `approved` or `rejected`. `note` (max 500 chars) is optional. Response: `{ success: true, data: <updated expense claim>, message: "Claim approved" }` (or "Claim rejected").
Requires permission: `expense_claims.mark_paid`. No body. Response: `{ success: true, data: <updated expense claim>, message: "Claim marked as paid" }`.
Requires permission: `expense_claims.view`. Streams the uploaded receipt file back as a download (not a JSON envelope) - response content-type/body is the raw file.

Requires permission: `delegations.view`. Both query params optional, default page=1/limit=50; not scoped to the caller - returns all delegations org-wide. Response: `{ success: true, data: { delegations: [<delegation>, ...], total } }`.

Requires permission: `delegations.create`. All four fields required: `userId` and `delegateId` (uuids, must differ), `startDate`/`endDate` (non-empty date strings). Response 201: `{ success: true, data: <new delegation>, message: "Delegation added" }`.
Requires permission: `delegations.delete`. 404 if not found. Response: `{ success: true, data: null, message: "Delegation removed" }`.

Requires permission: `approval_bands.view`. Both query params optional, default page=1/limit=50. Response: `{ success: true, data: { approvalBands: [<approval band>, ...], total } }`. Note: these configured bands are not currently consulted by any live approval/workflow logic.

Requires permission: `approval_bands.create`. `requestType` (one of: discount, customer_creation, credit_limit, expense_claim) and `bandName` are required; `rangeFrom`/`rangeTo` (numbers >= 0), `approverLevelId`/`countersignedByLevelId` (uuids), `slaHours`/`sortOrder` (integers) are all optional. Response 201: `{ success: true, data: <new approval band>, message: "Approval band created" }`.

Requires permission: `approval_bands.update`. Every field optional - send only what changes (same fields as Create, `rangeTo`/`approverLevelId`/`countersignedByLevelId`/`slaHours` may also be set to null). Response: `{ success: true, data: <updated approval band>, message: "Approval band updated" }`.
Requires permission: `approval_bands.delete`. Response: `{ success: true, data: null, message: "Approval band deleted" }`.

Requires: valid access token (no specific permission) - visibility is inherently self-scoped: leave/expense/FOFO-onboarding items are each only included if the caller actually holds `leave_requests.approve` / `expense_claims.approve` / `fofo_onboarding.manage` respectively, so a caller with none of those three just gets an empty inbox. Merges pending leave requests, expense claims and FOFO onboarding-push approvals the caller is waiting on into one unified queue. Response: `{ success: true, data: { items: [<queue item with type, title, value, waitingHours, isSlaBreach, refId, raw, ...>], stats: { waitingOnYou, breachingSla, valueInQueue, valueInQueueCount, approvedThisWeek, avgDecisionHours } } }`.

Requires permission: `territory_transfers.view`. Both query params optional, default page=1/limit=50. Admins see every scheduled transfer org-wide; everyone else sees only transfers where the from/to user is in their own reporting-chain subtree. Response: `{ success: true, data: { transfers: [<scheduled transfer>, ...], total } }`.

Requires permission: `territory_transfers.create`. `fromUserId` (uuid), `newTerritory` and `effectiveDate` are required; `note` is optional. Response 201: `{ success: true, data: <new scheduled transfer>, message: "Territory transfer scheduled" }`.

Requires permission: `leads.update` (this schedules a future lead-ownership move, so it is gated the same as the immediate bulk-reassign endpoint, not the `territory_transfers.*` permission). `fromUserId`, `toUserId` (uuids) and `effectiveDate` are required; `note` is optional. Response 201: `{ success: true, data: <new scheduled transfer>, message: "Bulk re-assign scheduled" }`.

Requires permission: `territory_transfers.create`. `fromUserId` (uuid) and `effectiveDate` are both required. Response 201: `{ success: true, data: <new scheduled transfer>, message: "Exit recorded" }`.
Requires: valid access token (no specific permission) - plain reference-data lookup, same as geography's zones/states. Response: `{ success: true, data: [{ id, label }, ...] }`.
Requires: valid access token (no specific permission) - plain reference-data lookup. Response: `{ success: true, data: [{ id, label }, ...] }`.

Requires permission: `fofo_onboarding.view`. Both query params optional, default page=1/limit=50. Returns FOFO-category leads owned by anyone in the caller's reporting-chain subtree. Response: `{ success: true, data: { leads: [<fofo lead summary with expectedValue>, ...], total } }`.
Requires permission: `fofo_onboarding.view`. Response: `{ success: true, data: <onboarding handoff: steps, documents, approval chain> }`.

Response: `{ success: true, data: { team: [ { id, name, territory, days: [ { date, tag } ], loadThisWeek } ], weekStart, stats: { headcount, availableToday, onLeaveToday, onLeaveUnapprovedToday, fieldVisitsToday, fieldVisitsPendingToday, avgActivitiesPerPerson, avgActivitiesPerPersonLastWeek } } }`. `tag` is one of: field, office, leave, weekly_off, none.

query.description: optional, "YYYY-MM" - filters leads created in that calendar month
optional, uuid - filters to one zone

request.description: Requires permission: `reports.view`. Both query params optional. Scoped to the caller's reporting subtree. Response: `{ success: true, data: [ { userId, name, leads, converted, conversionRate, revenue } ] }`.

Requires permission: `reports.view`. No params. Scoped to the caller's reporting subtree; only states with at least one lead are returned. `openTickets` is always `null` - FieldForce has no ticketing/order system to back it. Response: `{ success: true, data: [ { stateId, stateName, leads, customers, fofoLive, openTickets } ] }`.

Requires permission: `reports.view`. No params. Groups non-FOFO leads (FOFO has its own cohort-retention report below) by `category`. `avgOrder`/`overdue` are always `null` - no orders/invoicing data exists to back them. Response: `{ success: true, data: [ { category, accounts, revenue, avgOrder, overdue } ] }`.

Requires permission: `reports.view`. No params. Groups by the lead's inquiry source. `cost`/`cpql` are always `null` - no marketing spend is tracked anywhere in FieldForce. Response: `{ success: true, data: [ { source, leads, qualified, cost, cpql } ] }`.

Requires permission: `reports.view`. No params. Groups FOFO stores that have gone live by the month they were pushed live. `m3`/`m6`/`m12` retention figures are always `null` - nothing tracks post-launch ordering activity yet. Response: `{ success: true, data: [ { cohortMonth, stores, m3, m6, m12 } ] }`.

query.description: required - one of: salesperson, state_wise, b2b_group, lead_source_roi, fofo_cohort_retention (read directly from the query string, not schema-validated on this GET)

request.description: Requires permission: `reports.view`. Lists the caller's own saved filter presets for the given report. Response: `{ success: true, data: [ { id, reportKey, name, filters, createdAt } ] }`.

Requires permissions: `reports.view` and `reports.save_view`. `reportKey` is required (enum: salesperson, state_wise, b2b_group, lead_source_roi, fofo_cohort_retention) and `name` is required (1-150 chars); `filters` is an optional free-form object (defaults to `{}`), typically the query params currently applied on the matching report. Response 201: `{ success: true, data: <saved view>, message: "View saved" }`.

Requires permissions: `reports.view` and `reports.save_view`. Deletes one of the caller's own saved views (the delete is scoped by user id server-side, so it silently no-ops on another user's view id). Response: `{ success: true, data: null, message: "View removed" }`.

query.description: optional, relative in-app path to return to once the OAuth flow completes

request.description: Requires: valid access token (no specific permission). Returns a Microsoft sign-in URL as JSON rather than redirecting (this call must still carry the Bearer token, which a plain browser navigation can't) - the app opens the returned URL in a browser itself. Response: `{ success: true, data: { authUrl: string } }`.

query.description: signed state set by Microsoft's own redirect - identifies which CRM user is connecting, in place of a Bearer token

request.description: `auth: noauth` - the mobile app will never call this directly. This is the URL Microsoft's own servers redirect the browser to after the user approves access (started from "Start Microsoft Connection" above); the signed `state` query param stands in for the missing Authorization header. Included only for completeness. Response is an HTTP 302 redirect back to the frontend, not a JSON body.

Requires: valid access token (no specific permission). Whether the caller has personally connected a Microsoft 365 account (needed before the per-lead "Send Email"/"Create Teams Meeting" endpoints will work). Response: `{ success: true, data: { connected: boolean, email: string | null } }`.
Requires: valid access token (no specific permission). Removes the caller's own Microsoft 365 connection. Response: `{ success: true, data: null, message: "Microsoft 365 account disconnected" }`.

Requires permission: `users.view`. Settings > Users & access - org-wide visibility into which active users have linked their own Microsoft 365 account. Response: `{ success: true, data: [ { id, name, designation, connected, email } ] }`.

Requires permission: `users.update`. Lets an admin revoke someone else's Microsoft 365 connection (cannot complete a new sign-in on their behalf - that still has to be done by that user from their own profile). Response: `{ success: true, data: null, message: "Microsoft 365 account disconnected" }`.

header.description: shared secret, must match the server's SMARTFLO_WEBHOOK_SECRET env var

request.description: `auth: noauth` - called directly by Smartflo's own servers once a call hangs up, not by the mobile app (click-to-call itself is `POST /leads/{{leadId}}/call`, documented separately). Authenticated instead by a shared-secret header, `x-webhook-secret`, matched against the server's `SMARTFLO_WEBHOOK_SECRET` env var - 401 if missing/wrong. `ref_id` is the only field that matters for anything to happen (matches the call back to its logged activity); the rest are optional and merge into that activity's outcome/recording/duration. Response: `{ success: true, data: null, message: "ok" }`.

header.description: shared secret, must match the server's WHATSAPP_WEBHOOK_SECRET env var

request.description: `auth: noauth` - called directly by the WhatsApp provider's (K3) servers for inbound messages/delivery updates, not by the mobile app (per-lead WhatsApp send/list is `POST`/`GET /leads/{{leadId}}/whatsapp-messages`, documented separately). Authenticated instead by a shared-secret header, `x-webhook-secret`, matched against `WHATSAPP_WEBHOOK_SECRET` - 401 if missing/wrong. Body mirrors Meta's WhatsApp Cloud API webhook shape (`entry[].changes[].value.messages[]` for inbound text, matched to a lead by phone number). Response: `{ success: true, data: null, message: "ok" }`.

Requires: valid access token (no specific permission). Org-wide (env-configured) status for the WhatsApp and Smartflo integrations only - both are set via server environment variables, not a UI toggle. Microsoft 365 is per-user OAuth and has its own `/integrations/microsoft/status` above. Response: `{ success: true, data: { whatsapp: boolean, smartflo: boolean } }`.

item.name: Frappe Webhooks (server-to-server, not for mobile)
item.description: Both requests in this folder are called directly by Frappe's own Helpdesk servers (configured on HD Ticket's `on_update` event and Communication's `after_insert` event respectively) to sync support-ticket status/replies back into FieldForce. The mobile app will never call either of these - no Authorization header is ever sent here; an HMAC signature header, `X-Frappe-Webhook-Signature`, computed over the exact raw request body, stands in for auth instead. Included in this collection only for completeness.

header.description: HMAC signature computed over the raw request body; verified against Frappe's configured webhook secret

request.description: `auth: noauth` - server-to-server only, not for the mobile app (see folder note above). A missing/invalid `X-Frappe-Webhook-Signature` or a body that isn't valid JSON returns 401. `ticket_name` and `status` are required for the status sync to actually run; `priority` is optional. Response: `{ success: true, data: null, message: "ok" }`.

header.description: HMAC signature computed over the raw request body; verified against Frappe's configured webhook secret

request.description: `auth: noauth` - server-to-server only, not for the mobile app (see folder note above). Same HMAC verification as the Ticket Status Webhook above (401 on failure). `ticket_name`, `content`, and `communication_name` are all required for the inbound reply to be recorded against the ticket. Response: `{ success: true, data: null, message: "ok" }`.
